d:
Magadh men apna sab kuchh kho dene ke bad kishor vishnugupt takshashila ki or kuch karta hai. ek vyapari dhanashrishti ki madad se vishnu takshashila pahunch jata hai. vishvavidyalay ke kulapti dvara puchhe gae anek prashnon ke satik uttar de vishnugupt vahan pravesh pa leta hai aur yahan se praranbh hota hai vishnugupt ke jivan ka ek naya adhyaya. kya hota hai aage - dekhie is bhag men -
Episode 5 of a 47-part historical drama Chanakya. An epic Indian television series.
Written and directed by Dr. Chandraprakash Dwivedi.
Produced by
Prakash M Dwivedi.
Starring
